en.headline: Thunderstorm warning in force until 3pm
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory has issued a Thunderstorm Warning valid until 3 p.m., with thundery showers developing over southern and eastern areas.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a Thunderstorm Warning that remains in force until 3 p.m. on Saturday. A few squally thunderstorms are expected to affect Hong Kong.
Areas of thundery showers over the southern and eastern parts of the territory are developing gradually and are expected to affect wider areas in the coming hours, the Observatory said.
Members of the public are advised to take precautions, including seeking safe shelter if outdoors and staying away from highly conductive objects, trees or masts when thunderstorms occur.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告生效至下午3時
zh.dek: 天文台發出雷暴警告，有效至今日下午3時，南部及東部有雷雨區逐漸發展。
body: 香港天文台發出雷暴警告，現時繼續生效至今日下午3時。預期本港有局部地區出現狂風雷暴。
天文台表示，本港南部及東部有雷雨區正逐漸發展，預料未來數小時會影響較廣範圍。
市民如在戶外，應盡快找尋安全地方躲避，並遠離導電物體、樹木或桅杆。
